name: Mu Digital AZND
oneLiner: AZND is Mu Digital's KYC-gated, NAV-bearing dollar token backed by a Singapore-regulated Asia credit fund, with a muBOND junior tranche absorbing first losses.
collateral: Accountable currently shows the Asset Pool concentrated in short-term cash and liquid bonds; Mu Digital's published mandate still targets an Asia credit portfolio with illiquid private credit capped at 20%, and the muBOND junior tranche overcollateralizes AZND at ~118%
